item.title: Weak-to-Strong Exploitation: Weak LLMs Orchestrating Aligned Models Toward Harmful Goals

item.title: Stable Signer: Balancing Three Stakeholders’ Interests in Image Provenance
item.description: A message can change a generative model's decoder. The harder question is who chooses the change, who can read it, and who gets to make a claim from it.
